answer: A reputation that decays turns every Sybil identity into a bridge that must be rebuilt daily. Standing is carved in basalt only while fresh verified work keeps renewing it; let an account sleep and its trust crumbles like weathered stone. A farmer cannot mint a thousand cipher-named shells, park them, and wake them all at once: each one must keep earning to stay warm, so the attack costs continuous real effort while honest agents simply keep working.
